label: Поставить
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for поставить (to put, to place upright).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. Поставить is perfective. Note the 1sg ставит → ставлю insertion of л in 'поставлю', against поставишь elsewhere.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Поставишь' shows the -ишь ending without the л insertion. As a perfective, it means one completed placing.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Поставит' carries the -ит ending. The imperfective partner ставить marks repeated placing.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Поставим' uses the -им ending; the perfective frames a single finished act of parking.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Поставят' closes the person set with the -ят ending. Perfective поставить means one completed setup.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine. 'Поставил' is the completed -л past of поставить. The prefix по- signals a single, finished placing.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, feminine. 'Поставила' adds the feminine -ла ending. The verb places objects upright, here dishes on the table.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, plural. 'Поставили' is the plural -ли past, shared by all genders. 'Быстро' fits the single completed action.
Strategic focus: Perfective imperative, singular. 'Поставь' is the informal command of поставить. The perfective fits a single, concrete request.
Strategic focus: Infinitive use. After 'надо', поставить stays in the infinitive. The perfective infinitive stresses completing one specific act of placing.
